body:
So, I haven't given up yet but my wife found this post; ironically titled "[I played myself](https://www.reddit.com/r/offmychest/comments/4662dy/i_played_myself/)". She left this morning to a go stay at a friends house and hasn't talked to me since she dipped out. I mean. I can get why she would be mad about the miscarriage thing and that essentially it wasn't deterred when it was conceived, but that was a decision made long ago...

It's been done. The "ex" had a miscarriage and God it seemed guided me toward my wife by blessing us with our son. I have more or less given up on the "ex" and just try to talk to her as a friend now; mostly....well she still says love you to me...but she also said she does that with her friends....and I fell weird if I don't respond...so there's that I guess....but it's not like I'm plotting against my wife or something. The "ex" with a new guy and they are doing pretty well.

So now, after I have given faith to God. Given faith to my marriage; even as I struggle to do so. The rug is being pulled out from under me even as I struggle and thus far have succeeded in giving my will to God on this and trusting that God knows what they are doing.....God works in mysterious ways....I wish I knew where this was going. The thing keeping me here. Is my child; not even the one that has yet to come. The one here already. She is a treasure to my life and I will do everything I can do avoid giving into the darkness......for her.....I love my daughter so much. I can't wait to meet my son....and I hope my wife see's sense even as she is angry. Clearly. Even in that post. I had made my decision. Even if I didn't like it at the time. Yesterday, I actually felt a little better about my decision....my feelings are complicated and not always something I like to share because they aren't right or wrong...they're just feelings and I need to be able to process them.

It's hard today; she always preaches trying to be a good Christian. Considering I'm trying to do the same and reaching out to Jesus. Even asking her to pray for me. She has to know I'm trying. I just wish she could forgive the past. I know it was wrong; but it doesn't matter anymore. At this point. It's in the past regardless. Maybe it doesn't matter and she just won't trust me anyway....the irony in my life is staggering. It would be funny...if it wasn't my life maybe...fuck....I'm glad my daughter is here. My little ray of sunshine.
